notable_absence.finding: Table 9 (Configuration Options Reference) lists roughly 60 SDK-2-to-SDK-3 setting-name mappings ('sslEnabled -> SecurityConfig.enableTls', 'kvTimeout -> TimeoutConfig.kvTimeout', etc.). Only a small representative sample was captured as renamedFrom relations (view staleness, query index manager) rather than all ~60 rows - each row is individually quotable and would individually pass the evidence gate, but promoting every settings-rename row to its own concept would produce dozens of single-relation, never-revisited concepts for one page. Flagged here so reconciliation can decide whether bulk settings-rename tables like this one warrant a different, lower-overhead representation (e.g. one concept per table with a structured value payload) rather than one concept per row.

cross_component_finding: sdk:view-queries-with-sdk carries two independent constraints layered on top of each other: deprecatedIn version:server-7-0 (a version-gated fact) AND requiresCapability storage-engine:couchstore (a capability-gated fact, unrelated to version - Views require Couchstore at any version). Both are true simultaneously and neither substitutes for the other, illustrating that availableSince/deprecatedIn's version axis and requiresCapability's capability axis are orthogonal, not alternative ways of saying the same thing.
cross_product_finding: This page and 3.0-pre-release-notes.json (same batch) independently restate the identical Server-6.5 cluster-level-query threshold in different words ('cluster-level queries can now be performed without opening a bucket' here vs. 'cluster-level queries can now be performed without opening a bucket' in the alpha.6 changelog entry) - the fact survived unchanged from an alpha changelog entry all the way to the GA migration guide, giving sdk:cluster-level-query two independent verbatim-evidenced sources for the same availableSince relation rather than one guessed from context.
